blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The rapid growth of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in low-altitude airspace increases the risk of unauthorized intrusions, making reliable detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs essential for low-altitude airspace safety. However, the existing public UAV datasets are mostly acquired from fixed ground-based viewpoints and are limited to imaging or radio-frequency (RF) observations, which restricts the sensing coverage and deployment flexibility. To address this gap, we present A2A-UAV, a multimodal air-to-air dataset for UAV detection and identification. Specifically, 15 target UAVs of 13 commercial models were recorded at three outdoor sites under daytime and nighttime conditions by using a UAV-mounted platform equipped with an RGB-thermal gimbal camera, a panoramic camera, an RF spectrum analyzer, and a millimeter-wave radar. The dataset contains 105,294 time-aligned samples of RGB, panoramic, thermal, and RF time-frequency images and radar point clouds. Moreover, all 209,539 bounding boxes of the predominantly small UAV targets were manually annotated and cross-checked. Therefore, A2A-UAV provides a valuable resource for air-to-air UAV detection, identification, and multimodal fusion in low-altitude airspace.
blocks.zh: 低空空空域无人驾驶飞行器(UAVs)的快速发展增加了未经授权入侵的风险,使得对不合作的无人驾驶飞行器的可靠探测和识别对低空空域安全至关重要. 然而,现有的公共无人驾驶飞行器数据集大多是从固定的地基角度获取的,仅限于成像或射频(RF)观测,这限制了感知覆盖范围和部署的灵活性. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了A2A-UAV,这是一个用于无人驾驶航空器探测和识别的多式空对空数据集。 具体地说,在日间和夜间条件下,在三个户外地点记录了15个目标无人驾驶飞行器,这些无人驾驶飞行器搭载平台配备了RGB-热振相机、全景相机、RF频谱分析仪和毫米波雷达。 该数据集包含105,294个时间相通的RGB,全景,热能,和RF时间频率图像和雷达点云等样本. 此外,所有209,539个主要小型无人驾驶飞行器目标的捆绑箱都经过人工说明和交叉核对。 因此,A2A-UAV为低空空空域的空对空无人驾驶飞行器探测、识别和多模式聚变提供了宝贵的资源。

blocks.en: Background & Summary
blocks.zh: 背景摘要( T)

blocks.en:
The rapid development of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has enabled their wide deployment in logistics, infrastructure inspection, environmental monitoring, and emergency response 1 .
However, the low cost and accessibility of commercial UAVs also facilitate unauthorized operations, such as flights in restricted airspace and unauthorized surveillance of sensitive facilities, posing threats to public safety and critical infrastructure 2 .
The effective regulation and countermeasure of such UAVs rely on the timely perception of non-cooperative UAV targets, which do not broadcast their identity or position.
Therefore, accurate detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs are prerequisites for airspace monitoring, early warning, and subsequent countermeasures.
blocks.zh:
无人驾驶飞行器的迅速发展使其得以在后勤、基础设施检查、环境监测和应急措施1中广泛部署。
然而,商用无人驾驶飞行器的成本和可及性低也便利了未经授权的操作,例如限制领空的飞行和对敏感设施的未经授权的监视,对公共安全和关键基础设施构成威胁。
对这类无人驾驶飞行器的有效管制和反措施依赖于对不合作的无人驾驶飞行器目标及时的认识,这些目标不广播其身份或位置。
因此,准确探测和识别不合作的无人驾驶航空器是空气空间监测、预警和随后的对策的先决条件。

blocks.en:
Various sensing modalities have been investigated for the detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs.
Specifically, electro-optical cameras capture the appearance and shape of the target, and thermal infrared cameras record the thermal contrast between the target and the background 3 , 4 .
Radar sensors measure target range and radial velocity through the time delay and Doppler shift of reflected electromagnetic waves, independently of illumination conditions.
Moreover, passive radio-frequency (RF) sensors capture communication and control signals between UAVs and their remote controllers, providing complementary model-related information through spectral occupancy, frequency-hopping patterns, and modulation characteristics 5 .
blocks.zh:
已经对各种探测和识别不合作无人驾驶航空器的遥感方法进行了调查。
具体来说,电子光学照相机能捕捉到目标的外观和形状,热红外照相机能记录目标与背景3,4的热对比.
雷达传感器通过时间延迟和反射电磁波的多普勒偏移来测量目标范围和射线速度,独立于照明条件.
此外,被动射频传感器还能够捕捉无人驾驶飞行器与其遥控器之间的通信和控制信号,通过光谱占用、频断模式和调制特性提供互补的模型相关信息。

blocks.en:
Recent advances in deep learning have promoted data-driven methods for UAV detection and identification 4 , 6 .
The development and evaluation of these methods rely on large-scale sensor observations with reliable annotations.
Therefore, representative public datasets with standardized evaluation protocols are essential for the development, benchmarking, and reproducible comparison of these methods 5 , 7 .
blocks.zh:
近期在深入学习方面取得的进展促进了无人机探测和识别的数据驱动方法。
这些方法的开发和评价依赖于带有可靠说明的大规模传感器观测.
因此,具有标准化评价协议的有代表性的公共数据集对于制定、制定基准和复制这些方法的比较至关重要。

blocks.en:
Table I summarizes representative public UAV datasets in terms of the acquisition setting, the sensing modalities, and the availability of category labels.
The Drone-vs-Bird 8 and DUT Anti-UAV 2 datasets provide ground-to-air RGB observations for UAV detection and tracking.
Moreover, the Anti-UAV 3 benchmark and the multi-sensor drone detection dataset 9 provide both visible and thermal infrared observations.
Furthermore, the DroneRF 10 , CardRF 11 , and RFUAV 12 datasets provide RF recordings for UAV detection and identification, which were acquired by ground-based receivers or under controlled conditions.
However, these datasets rely on sensors at fixed ground locations, which constrains the available viewpoints and exposes the target observations to occlusion by buildings and vegetation.
blocks.zh:
表一总结了具有代表性的公共无人驾驶航空器数据集在获取设置、感知方式和类别标签的可得性方面的情况。
Drone-vs-Bird 8和DUT Anti-UAV 2数据集为无人机探测和跟踪提供地对空RGB观测.
此外,反无人机3号基准和多传感器无人机探测数据集9提供了可见和热红外观测。
此外,DroneRF 10、CardRF 11和RFUAV 12数据集为无人驾驶航空器的探测和识别提供了RF记录,这些记录是地面接收器或控制条件下获得的。
然而,这些数据集依靠固定地面位置的传感器,这限制了现有的观点,使目标观测暴露在建筑物和植被的包围之下。

blocks.en:
To overcome these limitations, UAV-mounted sensing provides a flexible platform for the detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs 13 .
Specifically, the airborne observer can adjust its position and viewing direction to maintain line-of-sight observations of the targets when ground-level observations are obstructed.
However, air-to-air observation differs fundamentally from ground-based observation. The simultaneous motion of the sensing platform and the target UAV causes continuous variations in viewing direction, target scale, and background, which alternates among the sky, terrain, buildings, and vegetation. Models trained on ground-to-air data, which are acquired from static viewpoints against predominantly sky backgrounds, are therefore not directly transferable to airborne observation, and dedicated air-to-air datasets are required.
Several datasets have been developed to investigate UAV perception in this air-to-air setting.
The Det-Fly 14 dataset provides RGB images for air-to-air micro-UAV detection, while the MOT-FLY 15 dataset provides visual sequences for multi-UAV tracking.
Recently, the MMFW-UAV 16 dataset introduced visible and thermal infrared imagery for fixed-wing UAV detection.
blocks.zh:
为克服这些局限性,无人机载感知为探测和识别不合作的无人机提供了灵活的平台。
具体而言,当地面观测受阻时,空降观察员可以调整其位置和观测方向,以保持对目标的视线观测.
然而,空对空观测与地面观测有着根本的不同. 感知平台与目标无人机同步运动,造成观测方向、目标尺度和背景持续变化,在天空、地形、建筑和植被中交替出现。 因此,从静态角度对照主要为天空背景获得的地面对空数据培训模型不能直接转用于空中观测,因此需要专门的空中对空数据集。
已经开发了多个数据集来调查这种空对空环境下的无人驾驶航空器感知.
Det-Fly 14数据集为空对空微UAV检测提供RGB图像,而MOT-FLY 15数据集为多UAV跟踪提供视觉序列.
最近,MMFW-UAV 16数据集引入了可见和热红外图像,用于固定翼无人机探测.

blocks.en:
Despite these advances, the existing air-to-air datasets are restricted to imaging modalities, which limits the joint analysis of heterogeneous sensing information.
Recent studies have shown that the complementary information from heterogeneous sensors can improve the robustness of UAV perception compared with single-modality approaches 17 , 5 .
However, the existing RF and radar UAV datasets 10 , 11 , 12 , 5 were acquired by ground-based sensors or under controlled conditions, and they generally do not provide visual observations of the same targets. As a result, the RF emissions and radar returns of UAVs observed from an airborne platform, as well as their association with the visual appearance of the same targets, cannot be investigated by using the existing public datasets.
Moreover, the existing air-to-air datasets rely on cameras with a limited field of view, which cover only a small part of the surrounding airspace.
In contrast, panoramic cameras capture the full surrounding airspace of the observer in a single frame, which enables the omnidirectional surveillance of non-cooperative UAVs without prior knowledge of the target direction.
Therefore, the lack of panoramic observations and airborne non-imaging observations with visual counterparts limits the development and evaluation of UAV detection and identification methods that exploit omnidirectional and heterogeneous sensing information.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的空对空数据集仅限于成像方式,这限制了对各种遥感信息的联合分析。
最近的研究表明,与单模式方法17、5相比,来自不同传感器的补充信息可以提高无人驾驶航空器感知的强度。
然而,现有的RF和雷达无人驾驶飞行器数据集10,11,12,5被地面传感器获得或在受控条件下获得,它们一般不提供相同目标的视觉观测. 因此,无法利用现有公共数据集来调查从空中平台观测到的无人驾驶飞行器的RF排放和雷达返回以及它们与同一目标的视觉外观的联系。
此外,现有的空对空数据集依赖于视野有限的摄像机,它们只覆盖周围空气空间的一小部分.
相比之下,全景摄像头以一个单一的框架来捕捉观察者整个周围的空域,这样就可以在没有事先知道目标方向的情况下对不合作的无人机进行全向监控.
因此,缺乏全景观测和与视觉对等的空载非成像观测限制了利用全向和异质感测信息的无人驾驶航空器探测和识别方法的发展和评价。

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we constructed A2A-UAV, a multimodal dataset for air-to-air UAV detection and identification.
The data were acquired by a UAV-mounted platform equipped with an RGB–thermal gimbal camera, a panoramic camera, an RF spectrum analyzer, and a millimeter-wave radar.
The platform observed 15 target UAVs of 13 commercial models, including three separately labeled DJI Mini 4 Pro units, in playground, park, and garden scenes under daytime and nighttime conditions.
To the best of our knowledge, A2A-UAV is the first air-to-air UAV dataset that provides time-aligned RGB, panoramic, thermal, RF, and radar observations of the same targets with category-level labels.
The main contributions of this dataset are summarized as follows.
blocks.zh:
为了消除这些局限性,我们建造了A2A-UAV,这是一个用于空中对空无人驾驶飞行器探测和识别的多式联运数据集。
这些数据由配备有RGB-热振幅相机、全景相机、RF频谱分析仪和毫米波雷达的无人驾驶航空器搭载平台获得。
该平台观察到13个商业型号的15个目标无人驾驶飞行器,包括3个单独标注的DJI Mini 4 Pro单元,在白天和夜间条件下的游乐场,公园和花园场景.
据我们所知,A2A-UAV是第一个空对空无人驾驶飞行器数据集,它提供时间对齐的RGB,全景,热,RF,和雷达对相同目标有类级标签的观测.
该数据集的主要贡献概述如下。

blocks.en:
• Five-modality air-to-air observations. A2A-UAV provides time-aligned RGB, panoramic, thermal infrared, RF time–frequency, and millimeter-wave radar observations of UAV targets acquired from an airborne platform. Specifically, the panoramic images cover the full surrounding airspace, the RF time–frequency images capture the model-related transmission characteristics, and the radar point clouds provide the spatial and radial-velocity measurements of the detected returns. • Real-flight data with high-quality annotations. The dataset comprises 105,294 samples acquired in three scenes under daytime and nighttime conditions. All 209,539 bounding boxes of the predominantly small UAV targets were manually annotated without automatic pre-annotation and subsequently cross-checked. • Diverse commercial UAV models. The 15 UAV labels of A2A-UAV cover 13 commercial models of different airframe designs, equipped with five transmission-system variants spanning several generations from OcuSync 2.0 to DJI O4+.
This diversity provides varied visual appearances and RF signatures, which supports the development and evaluation of UAV identification methods across models and transmission systems. • Support for flexible model development. A2A-UAV links the time-aligned observations, annotations, and metadata of each sample through a common sample identifier, which supports both single-modality and multimodal methods for UAV detection and identification.
The predefined recording-level training, validation, and test splits further provide a common basis for reproducible method comparison.

A2A-UAV提供时间对齐的RGB,全景,热红外线,RF时间–频率,以及从空中平台获取的UAV目标的毫米波雷达观测. 具体地说,全景图像覆盖了整个周围的空域,RF时间–频率图像捕捉模型相关的传输特性,雷达点云为检测到的返回提供了空间和射线速度的测量. • 有高质量说明的实时飞行数据。 该数据集包括105 294个在白天和夜间条件下在三个场景中采集的样本。 所有209 539个主要小型无人驾驶飞行器目标的捆绑箱都用人工说明,没有自动预先说明,随后进行了交叉核对。 • 各种商用无人驾驶航空器模型。 A2A-UAV的15个无人驾驶航空器标签覆盖了13个不同机体设计的商用模型,配备了5个传动系统变体,从OcuSync 2.0到DJI O4+跨越了几代人.

blocks.en:
1) The RF spectrum analyzer is a HAROGIC NXM-60 networked real-time analyzer 18 .
The analyzer was configured with a center frequency of 2.42 GHz, an IQ sampling rate of 125 MSa/s, with the in-phase and quadrature components stored as 16-bit integers. 2) The millimeter-wave radar unit uses a Texas Instruments IWR1843AOPEVM module with an integrated frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) sensor 19 . During data acquisition, the radar operated with three transmit and four receive channels. Each chirp started at 77 GHz and covered an effective sweep bandwidth of approximately 3.32 GHz. Moreover, the frame period was set to 50 ms. 3) The RGB–thermal gimbal camera is a Skydroid C12, which combines a 5-megapixel RGB camera and a thermal infrared camera on a three-axis stabilized mount 20 .
Specifically, the RGB camera has an F/2.0 aperture, a field of view of 100 ∘ × 52 ∘ 100^{\circ}\times 52^{\circ} , and a video resolution of 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 pixels.
Moreover, the thermal camera has a resolution of 384 × 288 384\times 288 pixels, a spectral range of 8–14 μ ​ m \mu\mathrm{m} , a field of view of 24.8 ∘ × 18.7 ∘ 24.8^{\circ}\times 18.7^{\circ} , and a frame rate of 25 Hz. 4) The panoramic camera is an Insta360 X5, which employs two 1/1.28-inch sensors with F/2.0 lenses and provides 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} angular coverage 21 .
During data acquisition, the camera recorded panoramic video at 5760 × 2880 5760\times 2880 pixels and 30 fps.

The target set comprised 15 individual UAVs representing 13 commercial models, including three separately labeled DJI Mini 4 Pro units, as summarized in Table III .

During each recording session, the airborne sensing platform took off first and established a stable observation position.
The target UAV then entered the monitored airspace, and both aircraft were manually piloted with a safe separation maintained between them.
The operator adjusted the position and heading of the sensing platform and the orientation of the camera gimbal to keep the target within the effective sensing region during repeated flight passes.
Moreover, the relative altitude and bearing between the two UAVs were varied across the passes, introducing changes in viewing direction, target scale, and background.
The acquisition procedure was repeated at the three sites under daytime and nighttime conditions to capture variations in background and illumination.
The operators of both the sensing platform and the target UAVs held valid civil unmanned aircraft pilot licenses issued by the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC) 25 .

blocks.en: Data Extraction and Multimodal Sample Construction
blocks.zh: 数据提取和多式联运样本建造

blocks.en:
The raw sensor recordings were processed into sample-level multimodal data products following the workflow illustrated in Fig. 2 .
During flight operations, the onboard computer recorded RGB, thermal, and radar streams in Robot Operating System (ROS) bag files.
The RGB and thermal frames were extracted and saved as PNG images at their recorded resolutions of 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 and 384 × 288 384\times 288 pixels, respectively.
RGB frames were stored as 24-bit PNG images (8 bits per channel), while thermal frames retained the bit depth and channel configuration of the recorded ROS image messages. Panoramic frames were extracted from the Insta360 X5 videos and saved as 24-bit PNG images at a resolution of 5760 × 2880 5760\times 2880 pixels.
Moreover, the radar messages were converted into point-cloud records, while the raw radio-frequency (RF) in-phase and quadrature (IQ) recordings were retained for the subsequent signal processing.
blocks.zh:
原始传感器录音按照图2所示工作流程加工成样本一级的多式联运数据产品。
在飞行操作中,机载计算机记录了机器人操作系统(ROS)包文件中的RGB,热流和雷达流.
RGB和热帧分别在其录制的1280×720 1280\times 720和384×288 384\times 288像素分辨率上被提取出来并作为PNG图像保存.
RGB帧作为24位 PNG 图像存储(每个通道8位),而热帧保留了录制的ROS图像信息的位深度和通道配置. 全景帧从Insta360 X5视频中提取,并以5760×2880 5760\times 2880像素的分辨率保存为24位PNG图像.
此外,雷达信息被转换成点云记录,而原无线电频率(RF)相位记录和四极(IQ)相位记录被保留下来,用于随后的信号处理.

blocks.en:
The recorded RF IQ data were converted into time–frequency images by using the short-time Fourier transform (STFT), and each RF acquisition recorded an IQ capture of 0.125 s. To make full use of each capture, three partially overlapping 0.1-s segments were extracted from its beginning, center, and end, and the central time of each segment was used as its acquisition timestamp.
Therefore, each RF time–frequency image is associated with the actual acquisition time of the IQ samples that it represents. For each segment, the mean complex value was subtracted to remove the direct-current component. A two-sided STFT was then computed by using a 1024-sample Hamming window, a 512-sample overlap, and a 1024-point fast Fourier transform (FFT).
The resulting spectrum was shifted to center the zero-baseband-frequency bin, corresponding to the receiver center frequency of 2.42 GHz. The squared magnitudes of the STFT coefficients were converted to a logarithmic power scale and visualized by using the jet color map.
The resulting time–frequency images were saved as 6000 × 3600 6000\times 3600 -pixel RGBA PNG files.
blocks.zh:
记录的RF IQ数据通过使用短时间Fourier变换(STFT)转换成时间-频率图像,每次RF收购记录的智商捕获量为0.125秒. 为了充分利用每次捕捉,从它的起始,中心,结束三个部分重叠的0.1秒的片段被提取出来,每个片段的中心时间被用作其获取时间戳.
因此,每个RF时间-频率图像与它所代表的智商样本的实际获取时间有关。 每段均减去平均复杂值,以删除直接流动部分。 然后采用1024-样本汉明窗口,512-样本重叠,1024点快速傅里叶变换(FFT)计算出双侧STFT.
由此产生的频谱被转移到了零基带频率本中心,相当于2.42GHz的接收中心频率. STFT系数的平方级被转换成对数功率尺度,并通过使用喷射色图可视化.
由此产生的时间–频率图像被保存为6000×3600-6000\times 3600 -像素RGBA PNG文件.

blocks.en: RGB, thermal, and panoramic frames were extracted by using reference timestamps generated at 4 Hz on a common session-level time axis. Because small and distant UAV targets produce sparse radar returns, all radar frames within ± 120 \pm 120 ms of the reference timestamp were assigned to the sample to increase the probability of capturing the target, with each frame saved as an individual CSV file. This 240-ms window is shorter than the 250-ms reference interval, ensuring that each radar frame belongs to at most one sample. Samples without any radar frame within the window were marked as radar-unavailable in the metadata.
blocks.zh: RGB,热,和全景框架都是通过在共同会话级时间轴上使用4Hz生成的参考时间戳提取的. 由于小型和远处的无人机目标产生稀疏的雷达回报,所以参考时间戳的±120\pm120毫秒范围内的所有雷达帧都被分配到样本中以提高捕获目标的概率,每个帧保存为单个的CSV文件. 这个240ms的窗口比250ms的参考间隔短,确保每个雷达帧最多属于一个样本. 窗口内没有任何雷达框架的样本在元数据中标为无法获取的雷达。

blocks.en:
The RF analyzer sampled the IQ data at 125 MSa/s with 16-bit in-phase and quadrature components, corresponding to a raw data rate of approximately 500 MB/s. To limit the volume of RF data collected during each flight session, RF signals were acquired as discrete 0.125-s IQ captures.
Accordingly, instead of frame-level alignment with the imaging streams, each sample was assigned the RF time–frequency image whose acquisition timestamp is nearest to its reference timestamp within the same recording.
This association is consistent with the role of the RF modality in A2A-UAV, which provides model-related transmission signatures for the UAV identification.
Specifically, each sample was assigned the RF time–frequency image with the nearest acquisition timestamp within the same recording.
Each recording contains a single target UAV, and the hopping pattern, occupied bandwidth, and frame structure of the RF emissions are determined by the transmission system of the target rather than by its instantaneous position relative to the sensing platform.
Therefore, the nearest RF time–frequency image provides a representative transmission signature of the target in the sample.
Moreover, the samples that share the same RF time–frequency image belong to the same recording and are assigned to the same partition, which prevents RF information leakage across partitions.
blocks.zh:
RF分析器对125 MSA/s的智商数据进行了抽样,其相位和四位元组成为16位,相当于大约500 MB/s的原始数据速率. 为了限制每次飞行过程中收集的RF数据量,RF信号作为离散的0.125s智商捕获而获得.
因此,每个样本不是与成像流相匹配,而是被分配RF时间-频率图像,其获取时间戳距同一记录中的参考时间戳最近。
这种关联符合RF模式在A2A-UAV中的作用,它为UAV识别提供了模式相关的传输签名.
具体地说,每个样本都被分配到RF时间 - 频率图像,在同一记录中拥有最近的购置时间戳。
每次录制都包含一个单一的目标无人驾驶航空器,RF排放量的跳动模式、占用的带宽和框架结构由目标的传输系统而不是其相对于感知平台的瞬间位置决定。
因此,最近的RF时间–频率图像提供了样本中目标的代表性传输签名.
此外,相同RF时间-频率图像的样本属于同一记录,并被分配到同一个分区,这可以防止RF信息跨分区泄露.

blocks.en: Data Annotation Procedures
blocks.zh: 数据注释程序

blocks.en:
The RGB and panoramic images were annotated separately with bounding boxes.
All annotations were performed manually by using Label Studio 26 , without automatic pre-annotation, frame interpolation, or tracking-based propagation.
Specifically, each image was annotated individually following a common guideline that required bounding boxes to tightly enclose the visible extent of the UAV, including the fuselage, arms, and propellers.
For partially occluded or truncated targets, the bounding boxes were drawn according to the visible portions of the UAV.
Moreover, each bounding box was assigned a UAV label based on the flight logs, which identified the target UAV in each recording session.
blocks.zh:
RGB和全景图像分别附有边框注解.
所有说明都是通过使用Label Studio 26手动执行的,没有自动预注,帧插图,也没有基于跟踪的传播.
具体地说,每个图像都按照共同的准则分别附加说明,该准则要求捆绑箱紧密地包裹无人驾驶航空器的可见范围,包括机身、武器和螺旋桨。
对于部分闭合或截断的目标,根据无人驾驶航空器的可见部分绘制了捆绑箱。
此外,每个捆绑箱都根据飞行日志被分配了一个无人驾驶航空器标签,在每次录制过程中都确定了目标无人驾驶航空器。

blocks.en: Data Quality Control
blocks.zh: 数据质量 控件

blocks.en:
Following the labeling stage in Fig. 2 , all bounding boxes underwent a manual cross-check and refinement, and the missing, duplicate, inaccurate, and incorrectly labeled annotations were corrected.
The exported records were then validated for missing modalities, duplicate records, out-of-range boxes, and unknown labels.
Specifically, the samples with a missing or unreadable image modality and the duplicate records were removed.
Moreover, the bounding boxes beyond the image boundaries were corrected, and the labels outside the 15 predefined UAV labels were reassigned.
Furthermore, the samples with more than one bounding box in either image or without a bounding box in both images were excluded.
The 1,049 image records without a bounding box were retained, because the target could leave the field of view of one camera while remaining visible in the other.
Finally, a privacy audit was conducted on the RGB images by using automatic face and license-plate detectors, and the confirmed faces were blurred in the released images.
blocks.zh:
在图2的标签阶段之后,所有绑定框都经过人工核对和完善,并纠正了缺少、重复、不准确和标签错误的说明。
出口记录随后被验证为缺失模式、重复记录、外框和未知标签。
具体来说,带有缺失或无法读取的图像模式的样本和复制记录被移除.
此外,超过图像边界的边框被纠正,15个预先定义的无人驾驶航空器标签以外的标签被重新分配.
此外,在图像中或两个图像中都有一个以上边框的样本被排除在外。
1049张没有边框的图像记录被保留下来,因为目标可以离开一个相机的视野而留在另一个相机的可见度.
最后,通过使用自动面板和许可证牌检测器对RGB图像进行了隐私审计,确认的面板在发布的图像中模糊不清.

blocks.en: Dataset Partitioning
blocks.zh: 数据集分区

blocks.en:
The A2A-UAV dataset was partitioned at the recording level after annotation and quality control. Each canonical recording identifier represents a continuous recording of a single target UAV acquired in one scene under one illumination condition. All samples generated from the same recording group were assigned to the same partition, and their associated modality files and annotations were retained with the corresponding samples. The training, validation, and test sets contain 68, 15, and 26 recording groups, respectively.
Table IV summarizes the sample and annotation counts for each partition, together with the total radar-sample and radar-frame counts. This recording-level design keeps temporally adjacent samples from the same recording within a single partition, which reduces the risk of information leakage. All 15 UAV labels are represented in each partition, providing label coverage for subsequent evaluation on the validation and test sets.

A2A-UAV数据集经过注释和质量控制后在记录层进行分区. 每一个犬科记录识别器代表在一个照明条件下在一个场景中获得的单个目标无人驾驶航空器的连续记录. 同一录制组产生的所有样本都被分配到同一个分区,其相关的模式文件和说明也保留了相应的样本. 培训、鉴定和测试组分别包含68、15和26个录音组。
表四汇总了每个分区的样品和注释计数,以及雷达样本和雷达帧计数总数。 这种记录级别设计将同一记录的样本在时间上相邻保存在一个分区内,从而减少了信息泄漏的风险。 所有15个无人驾驶飞行器标签都出现在每个分区中,为随后对验证和测试集的评价提供标签覆盖.

blocks.en: Repository Structure
blocks.zh: 仓库结构

blocks.en:
Fig. 4 illustrates the organization of the A2A-UAV release, with UAV_full_dataset_release/ as the root directory.
Specifically, the release is organized into six main subdirectories, namely images/ , annotations/ , manifests/ , reports/ , metadata/ , and scripts/ .
The images/ directory stores the multimodal products and sample metadata in the predefined train/ , val/ , and test/ splits, with one directory for each sample. The annotations/ directory contains the corresponding COCO-style bounding-box annotations.
The manifests/ directory provides sample-level JSON Lines (JSONL) records describing split membership, modality paths, and annotation metadata, while the reports/ directory contains the release summary and integrity report.
Additional metadata and supporting scripts are organized under metadata/ and scripts/ , respectively.
Moreover, the root directory also includes documentation files describing the dataset, licensing information, citation metadata, and file checksums.
blocks.zh:

具体来说,发行分为六个主要子目录,即图像/,说明/,表/,报告/,元数据/,和脚本/.
图像/目录将多式联运产品和样本元数据存储在预定义的列车/,val/,以及测试/拆分中,每个样本有一个目录. 说明/目录包含相应的COCO风格的边框说明.

更多的元数据和辅助脚本分别列在元数据/和脚本/下.

blocks.en: File Naming
blocks.zh: 文件命名

blocks.en:
Sample directories follow the pattern images/<split>/<sample_id>/ . The split names train , val , and test denote the training, validation, and test sets. Each sample identifier combines the corresponding prefix tr , va , or te with a six-digit anonymized sample number. For example, images/train/tr_000001/ denotes the directory for the training sample tr_000001 .
Within each sample directory, rgb.png , panorama_lr.png , thermal.png , and spectrum_tf.png store the RGB, panoramic, thermal, and RF time–frequency images, respectively. The file metadata.json stores the associated sample-level metadata. When radar observations are available, each radar frame is stored as a separate CSV file under radar/ , following the pattern radar/frame_NNN.csv , where NNN is a zero-padded three-digit frame index. The same sample identifier is recorded in the metadata, JSONL split manifests, and RGB and panoramic COCO image records.
Moreover, this shared identifier links the modality files and bounding-box annotations to the corresponding sample.
blocks.zh:
样本目录遵循图案图像/<split>/<sample_id>/. 分名列车、Val型列车和测试是指培训、验证和测试装置。 每个样本标识符将相应的前缀 tr, va, 或 te 与一个六位数的匿名样本编号结合. 例如,图像/train/tr_000001/表示培训样本的目录tr_000001。
在每个样本目录中, rgb.png, 全景_lr.png, 热.png, 和频谱_tf.png 分别存储 RGB,全景,热, 和 RF 时间 - 频率图像 。 文件元数据. json存储相关的样本级元数据. 当雷达观测可用时,每个雷达帧都作为单独的CSV文件存储在雷达/ 下,遵循图案雷达/帧_NNN.csv,其中NNN是一个零加三位数帧索引. 同样的样本标识符被记录在元数据,JSONL分裂表,以及RGB和全景COCO图像记录中.
此外,这个共享的标识符将模式文件和边框说明与相应的样本联系起来.

blocks.en: Data Properties
blocks.zh: 数据属性

blocks.en:
Each sample directory contains the RGB, panoramic, thermal, and RF time–frequency images and a metadata file.
Specifically, the radar point cloud is available for 105,263 samples, and the 31 retained samples had no radar frame within the temporal window and were marked as radar-unavailable in the metadata.
The 105,263 samples contain 505,673 radar frames in total, and each sample with radar observations is associated with one to six frames.
Table V summarizes the format and availability of each released product.
The metadata.json file records the sample identifier, the split assignment, the scene and illumination labels, the modality availability, and the RGB and panoramic annotations.
Moreover, all image products are stored as lossless PNG files and the RF time–frequency images are rendered by using the jet color map.
The horizontal axis spans the 0.1-s segment, the vertical axis spans 2.3575 to 2.4825 GHz, and the color represents the relative logarithmic power within each image.
Furthermore, each radar-frame CSV file stores one point per row with the fields x , y , z , intensity , and velocity .
The coordinates are given in meters in the radar sensor frame, and the velocity denotes the radial velocity in meters per second.
blocks.zh:
每个样本目录包含RGB,全景,热,和RF时间 -频率图像和一个元数据文件.
具体而言,有105 263个样本可用雷达点云,31个保留样本在时间窗口内没有雷达框架,在元数据中标为无法获取的雷达。
105,263个样本共包含505,673个雷达帧,每个带有雷达观测的样本都与1至6个帧相关.
表五总结了每种释放产品的格式和可得性。
元数据.json文件记录样本标识符,拆分任务,场景和照明标签,模式可用性,以及RGB和全景说明.
此外,所有图像产品都作为无丢失的PNG文件存储,RF时间-频率图像通过使用喷气色图来渲染.
水平轴横跨0.1-s段,垂直轴横跨2.3575至2.4825GHz,颜色代表每个图像内的相对对数功率.
此外,每个雷达框架的CSV文件每行存储一个点,并有x、y、z、强度和速度。
坐标在雷达传感器框中以米表示,速度以米每秒表示射线速度.

blocks.en:
The bounding boxes are provided in two formats.
The metadata.json files and the JSONL manifests record each box as [ x min , y min , x max , y max ] [x_{\min},y_{\min},x_{\max},y_{\max}] in pixel coordinates, with the origin at the top-left corner of the image.
The COCO-style annotation files follow the standard COCO format [ x min , y min , w , h ] [x_{\min},y_{\min},w,h] .
Moreover, each box is assigned one of the 15 UAV labels listed in Table VI , and each COCO-style image record includes a modality field that distinguishes the RGB images from the panoramic images.
blocks.zh:
边框以两种形式提供。
元数据.json文件和JSONL显示的每个框在像素坐标中记录为 [x min, y min, x max, y max] [x min], y min}, x max}, y max}], 来源在图像的左上角.

blocks.en: Dataset Analysis
blocks.zh: 数据集分析

blocks.en:
The A2A-UAV dataset contains 105,294 samples with 15 UAV labels.
Specifically, the playground, park, and garden scenes contribute 30,113, 43,502, and 31,679 samples, respectively, and the daytime and nighttime conditions contribute 52,162 and 53,132 samples, respectively.
Each sample provides one RGB image and one panoramic image for annotation, which yields 210,588 image records and 209,539 bounding boxes.
Moreover, the number of boxes per label ranges from 9,098 to 20,135, as listed in Table VI .
blocks.zh:
A2A-UAV数据集包含105,294个样本,并有15个UAV标签.
具体来说,游乐场,公园和花园的场景分别提供了30,113,43,502和31,679个样本,白天和晚上的条件分别提供了52,162和53,132个样本.
每个样本提供1个RGB图像和1个全景图像进行注解,生成210,588个图像记录和209,539个边框.
此外,如表六所示,每个标签的盒数从9 098个到20 135个不等。

blocks.en:
Fig. 5 characterizes the target positions and scales.
The RGB box centers concentrate around the image center because the gimbal was oriented to keep the target within the field of view.
The panoramic box centers concentrate near the horizontal center line, which corresponds to the near-horizontal lines of sight between the two UAVs.
Moreover, the median ratio of the box area to the image area is 3.58 × 10 − 4 3.58\times 10^{-4} for the 104,871 RGB boxes and 2.84 × 10 − 5 2.84\times 10^{-5} for the 104,668 panoramic boxes.
Furthermore, 86.0% of the RGB boxes and 77.0% of the panoramic boxes fall within the COCO small-object range below 32 2 32^{2} pixels 27 .
The panoramic targets have a median area of approximately 470 pixels, which exceeds the approximately 330 pixels of the RGB targets because of the higher panoramic resolution.
The RGB-to-panoramic ratio of the median normalized area remains between 12.1 and 13.4 across the three scenes.

全景箱中心集中在水平中心线附近,这与两台无人机之间的近横向视线相对应.

全景目标中位面积约为470像素,由于全景分辨率较高,超过了RGB目标中约330像素.

blocks.en:
Fig. 6 further compares the target scales across illumination conditions, box shapes, and UAV labels.
The daytime and nighttime scale distributions overlap substantially.
Moreover, most bounding boxes have width-to-height ratios greater than 2 : 1 2{:}1 , as shown by the concentration of points below the corresponding reference line.
Furthermore, the median area ratio of every UAV label remains on the order of 10 − 4 10^{-4} .
Therefore, the small-target characteristic holds across illumination conditions, imaging modalities, and UAV labels.
blocks.zh:
图6还比较了不同照明条件、箱形和无人驾驶航空器标签的目标尺度。
白天和夜间的分布高度重叠。
此外,大多数边框的宽度对高比大于2:1 2{:}1,如相应参考线下点的集中所示.
此外,每个无人驾驶航空器标签的中位面积比例仍然在10-4 10 QQ-4}左右。
因此,小目标特征跨越照明条件、成像方式和无人驾驶航空器标签。

blocks.en:
Fig. 7 presents representative RF time–frequency images for the 15 UAV labels.
The transmission systems of the target UAVs maintain a bidirectional link between the UAV and the remote controller, and the two link directions exhibit distinct time–frequency signatures.
Specifically, the uplink command-and-control signal from the remote controller appears as short bursts of a few megahertz that hop across the 2.4 GHz band.
Moreover, the downlink signal from the UAV carries the video and telemetry streams and appears as wideband OFDM blocks with a bandwidth of 10 to 40 MHz.
Furthermore, the burst duration, the hopping interval, the occupied bandwidth, and the frame periodicity vary across UAV models.
Therefore, different UAV models exhibit distinguishable time–frequency patterns, and the three DJI Mini 4 Pro units exhibit closely similar patterns.
These model-dependent signatures provide the discriminative information for RF-based UAV identification.
blocks.zh:
图7为15个无人驾驶航空器标签提供了具有代表性的RF时间-频率图像。
目标无人驾驶飞行器的传输系统在无人驾驶飞行器和遥控器之间保持双向联系,两个联系方向显示出不同的时间-频率签名。
具体地说,远程控制器的上行链路指令与控制信号出现为几兆赫的短发,跳过2.4GHz波段.
此外,来自无人机的下行链路信号载有视频和遥测流,并作为带宽为10至40兆赫的OFDM块出现。
此外,不同无人驾驶航空器模型的爆炸持续时间、购物间隔、占用的带宽和帧周期也各不相同。
因此,不同的无人驾驶飞行器模型显示出可区分的时间-频率模式,三个DJI Mini 4 Pro单元显示出非常相似的模式。
这些依赖模型的签名为基于RF的无人驾驶航空器识别提供了歧视性信息.

blocks.en: Technical Validation
blocks.zh: 技术鉴定

blocks.en:
UAV detection and identification are two fundamental tasks for low-altitude airspace monitoring.
Specifically, UAV detection localizes the target UAV in the image coordinate system, and UAV identification determines the category of the target UAV.
Therefore, A2A-UAV is designed to support the detection and identification of UAVs from an air-to-air perspective.
blocks.zh:
无人机探测和识别是低空空空域监测的两项基本任务.
具体而言,无人驾驶飞行器探测在图像坐标系统中将目标无人驾驶飞行器定位,无人驾驶飞行器识别决定目标无人驾驶飞行器的类别.
因此,A2A-UAV的设计是为了支持从空对空的角度检测和识别无人机.

blocks.en: Model Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 示范实施 细节

blocks.en:
The detection benchmarks were implemented by using MMDetection 28 , and all 15 UAV labels were mapped to a single foreground category.
Specifically, Faster R-CNN 29 , Dynamic R-CNN 30 , Cascade R-CNN 31 , Sparse R-CNN 32 , DINO 33 , DDQ 34 , and FCOS-KL 35 were evaluated on both the RGB and panoramic images.
All detectors used ResNet-50 backbones.
Moreover, each RGB image was resized to fit within 1706 × 960 1706\times 960 pixels while preserving its aspect ratio, and each panoramic image was divided into 18 tiles of 1280 × 1280 1280\times 1280 pixels with a stride of 1024 pixels.
The tile predictions were mapped back to the original image coordinates and merged by the non-maximum suppression with an IoU threshold of 0.55.
The experiments were conducted by using PyTorch 2.1.0 and MMDetection 3.3.0 on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPUs.
The detection performance was evaluated by using the COCO metrics, where AP averages the precision over IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95, and AP S , AP M , and AP L correspond to the boxes with areas below 32 2 32^{2} , between 32 2 32^{2} and 96 2 96^{2} , and above 96 2 96^{2} pixels, respectively.
blocks.zh:
检测基准是通过使用MM检测28来实现的,所有15个无人驾驶航空器标签均被绘制成单一的前缘类别。
具体而言,在RGB和全景图像上评价了更快的R-CNN 29、动态R-CNN 30、连锁R-CNN 31、Sparse R-CNN 32、DINO 33、DDQ 34和FCOS-KL 35。
所有探测器都使用了ResNet-50主干线.
此外,每个RGB的图像在保留其侧面比的同时被调整为1706×960 1706\times 960像素的尺寸,每个全景图像被分为18块1280×1280\times 1280像素的平面,步幅为1024像素.
瓦片的预测被映射回原图像坐标,并由非最大压制合并为IoU阈值0.55.
这些实验是通过在NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU上使用PyTorch 2.1.0和MM探测器3.3.0进行的。
检测性能通过COCO度量评价,AP比IoU阈值的精度平均值为0.50至0.95,APS,APM,和APL对应的框面积分别为32,2,32^{2}至96,2,96^{2},以及96,2,96^{2}像素以上.

blocks.en:
The identification benchmark used the RF time–frequency images as the input and covered all 15 UAV labels.
Specifically, the 6000 × 3600 6000\times 3600 -pixel RGBA spectrograms were converted into three-channel images of 1333 × 800 1333\times 800 pixels.
Six identification networks were evaluated, namely ResNet-18 and ResNet-50 36 , EfficientNet-V2-S 37 , ConvNeXt-Tiny 38 , Swin-T 39 , and MobileNet-V3-Large 40 .
The checkpoint with the highest validation macro-F1 score was selected for testing.
blocks.zh:
识别基准使用RF时间-频率图像作为输入,并覆盖所有15个无人驾驶航空器标签。
具体来说,6000×36006000\times3600-像素RGBA光谱被转换成333×8001333\times800像素的三通道图像.
评价了6个识别网络,即ResNet-18和ResNet-50 36、高效率网络-V2-S 37、ConvNEXt-Tiny 38、Swin-T 39和MobileNet-V3-Large 40。
考核结果最高的检查站宏-F1分数入选测试.

blocks.en: UAV Detection Results
blocks.zh: UAV 检测结果

blocks.en:
The left half of Table VII presents the UAV detection results on the panoramic test images.
Specifically, Faster R-CNN achieved the highest AP of 0.1983, AP50 of 0.5010, AP S of 0.1660, and AP M of 0.3264.
Moreover, Cascade R-CNN achieved the highest AP75 of 0.1203, and Dynamic R-CNN achieved the highest AP L of 0.0514.
Furthermore, the AP S of the panoramic baselines ranged from 0.0507 to 0.1660.
The panoramic targets occupy a median of 2.84 × 10 − 5 2.84\times 10^{-5} of the image area, and the equirectangular projection further distorts the target appearance.
Therefore, the small target size and the projection distortion make panoramic UAV detection the more challenging of the two protocols.
The low AP L results from the scarcity of large panoramic targets, which account for less than 1% of the panoramic boxes.
blocks.zh:
表七的左半部分介绍了全景测试图像上的无人驾驶航空器检测结果.
具体而言,更快的R-CNN实现了最高的AP(0.1983),AP50(0.5010),APS(0.1660)和APM(0.3264).
此外,Cascade R-CNN实现了0.1203的最高AP75,动态R-CNN实现了0.0514的最高APL.
此外,《附加议定书》 全景基线的S从0.0507到0.1660.
全景目标占据了图像区域的中位数2.84×10 − 5 2.84\times 10×5},等角投影进一步扭曲了目标外观.
因此,小的目标大小和投影扭曲使得全景无人机探测更具有挑战性两个协议.
低级AP L因大型全景目标稀少,占全景盒的不到1%.

blocks.en: TABLE VII: UAV detection results on panoramic (left) and RGB (right) test images. Bold values indicate the best result for each metric within each modality.
blocks.zh: 表七:全景(左)和RGB(右)测试图像上的无人机检测结果. 粗体值表示每个模式内每个度量的最佳结果。

blocks.en:
The right half of Table VII presents the results on the RGB test images.
Specifically, Cascade R-CNN achieved the highest AP of 0.2860, AP75 of 0.1860, AP S of 0.2700, and AP M of 0.3990.
Moreover, Faster R-CNN and Dynamic R-CNN achieved the same highest AP50 of 0.6850, and Dynamic R-CNN achieved the highest AP L of 0.4840.
Compared with the panoramic protocol, the best AP and the best AP S on the RGB images were higher by 0.0877 and 0.1040, respectively.
The higher RGB performance results from the larger relative target size and the absence of projection distortion.
blocks.zh:
表七的右半部分介绍了RGB测试图像的结果.
具体而言,Cascade R-CNN实现了最高的AP0.2860,AP750.1860,APS0.270,APM0.3990.
此外,更快的R-CNN和动态R-CNN实现了同样最高的AP500.6850,动态R-CNN实现了最高的APL0.4840.
与全景协议相比,RGB图像上最佳AP和最佳AP S分别高出0.0877和0.1040.
RGB性能较高是因为相对目标大小较大,且没有投影扭曲.

blocks.en:
Across both protocols, the highest values of all metrics were achieved by the two-stage detectors, namely Faster R-CNN, Cascade R-CNN, and Dynamic R-CNN, which refine region proposals on high-resolution feature maps and thereby preserve the features of small UAV targets.
Moreover, AP75 was substantially lower than AP50, with the best AP75 of 0.1203 and 0.1860 compared with the best AP50 of 0.5010 and 0.6850 on the panoramic and RGB images, respectively.
For small targets, an offset of a few pixels causes a large reduction in IoU.
Specifically, an offset of 3 pixels in both directions reduces the IoU of an 18 × 18 18\times 18 -pixel box, which corresponds to the median RGB target size, to 0.53.
Therefore, future air-to-air UAV detectors should preserve the fine-grained features of small targets, improve the localization precision, and account for the projection distortion of panoramic images.
blocks.zh:
在这两项议定书中,所有度量衡的最高值都由两个阶段的探测器实现,即更快的R-CNN、Casade R-CNN和动态的R-CNN,它们完善了区域关于高分辨率特征图的建议,从而维护了小型无人驾驶航空器目标的特点。
此外,AP75大大低于AP50,最佳AP75为0.1203和0.1860,而全景图像和RGB图像上最佳AP50分别为0.5010和0.6850.
对于小目标,一些像素的抵消导致IoU的大量减少.
具体来说,双向3像素的抵消将18×1818\time18-像素盒的IoU降低到0.53,与RGB目标中位数大小相对应.
因此,未来的空对空无人机探测器应当保持小目标精细的特征,提高本地化精度,并计入全景图像的投影扭曲.

blocks.en:
Fig. 8 further presents the Faster R-CNN detections on paired RGB and panoramic validation images across the three scenes under daytime and nighttime conditions, with all predictions of confidence scores of at least 0.5 displayed.
In the daytime images, the UAV targets were detected with confidence scores between 0.91 and 1.00.
Moreover, the confidence scores decreased to between 0.76 and 0.98 in the nighttime images, where the UAV appears mainly as a light spot without a visible contour.
Furthermore, false positives occurred on background regions that resemble the appearance of distant UAV targets.
Therefore, the discrimination between small UAV targets and similar background objects remains a key challenge for air-to-air UAV detection.
blocks.zh:
图8还展示了在白天和夜间条件下,在三个场景的配对RGB和全景验证图像上更快的R-CNN检测结果,所有自信分数的预测都至少显示在0.5.
在白天的图像中,检测到的无人机目标有0.91到1.00之间的置信分.
此外,在夜间图像中,置信分数下降到0.76到0.98之间,其中无人机主要作为没有可见轮廓的光斑出现.
此外,一些背景区域出现了假阳性,与遥远的无人驾驶航空器目标类似。
因此,小型无人驾驶飞行器目标与类似背景物体之间的区别仍然是空中无人驾驶飞行器探测的一个主要挑战。

blocks.en: UAV Identification Results
blocks.zh: 无人驾驶航空器识别结果

blocks.en:
Table VIII demonstrates the RF-based identification results of the six identification networks on the test images over the 15 UAV labels.
The accuracy measures the proportion of correctly classified samples, the balanced accuracy averages the recall over the 15 labels, and the macro-F1 averages the F1 score over the 15 labels with equal weight.
EfficientNet-V2-S achieved the highest accuracy of 69.32%, balanced accuracy of 78.46%, and macro-F1 of 74.17%.
Moreover, MobileNet-V3-Large achieved the second-highest values of all three metrics, and both lightweight networks outperformed the deeper ResNet-50.
blocks.zh:
表八显示在15个无人驾驶航空器标签的试验图像上六个识别网络的RF识别结果。
准确度衡量正确分类样本的比例,平衡准确度平均15个标签的召回,宏观-F1平均F1分比15个标签的相同重量.
高效Net-V2-S实现最高精度69.32%,平衡精度78.46%,宏F1达到74.17%.
此外,MobileNet-V3-Large实现了所有三个度量衡的第二高值,两个轻量级网络都超过了更深层次的ResNet-50。

blocks.en:
Fig. 9 presents the row-normalized confusion matrix of EfficientNet-V2-S on the test images, where the diagonal entries represent the recall of each label.
The recall reached 100% for a1 , air2s , and avata2 , and decreased to 15.70%, 48.20%, and 52.24% for mini4pro_xm , mini3pro , and mini4pro_z , respectively.
Specifically, 62.02% of the mini4pro_xm samples were classified as mini4pro_csq , and the confusion among the three DJI Mini 4 Pro units accounted for 32.79% of all test errors.
The three units share an identical transmission protocol, and their differences are limited to subtle hardware-induced characteristics.
Moreover, 38.92% of the air3 samples were classified as air3s , and the two models share the same O4 transmission system.
Therefore, future RF-based UAV identification methods should exploit fine-grained hardware characteristics beyond the protocol-level time–frequency patterns to distinguish the UAV models and individual units that share the same transmission system.
blocks.zh:
图9在测试图像上呈现了高效Net-V2-S的行常态混淆矩阵,其中对角条目代表每个标签的召回.
A1、Air2和Avata2的召回率分别下降到15.70%、48.20%和52.24%。
具体来说,62.02%的小型4pro_xm样本被归类为微型4pro_csq,以及三个DJI之间的混淆. Mini 4 Pro单元占所有测试错误的32.79%.
这三个单元共享一个相同的传输协议,它们的区别仅限于微妙的硬件诱导特征.
此外,38.92%的空气3样本被归类为空气3,两种模型共用相同的O4传输系统.
因此,未来的基于RF的无人驾驶飞行器识别方法应当利用超出协议级别时间-频率模式的细纹硬件特性,以区分具有相同传输系统的无人驾驶飞行器模型和单个单元。

blocks.en: Usage Notes
blocks.zh: 使用说明

blocks.en:
The dataset provides synchronized RGB, panoramic, thermal, RF time–frequency, and radar observations of 13 commercial UAV models in air-to-air scenarios, together with bounding-box annotations in both the per-sample JSON format and the COCO format.
Moreover, the three acquisition scenes and the daytime and nighttime conditions cover a wide range of backgrounds and illumination levels.
Therefore, A2A-UAV supports several research and engineering applications as follows.
blocks.zh:
该数据集提供同步的RGB,全景,热,RF时间-频率,以及空中对空情景中13种商用无人机模型的雷达观测,同时提供每样样JSON格式和COCO格式的边框说明.
此外,三个收购场景以及白天和夜间的条件涵盖了广泛的背景和照明水平.
因此,A2A-UAV支持如下几种研究和工程应用.

blocks.en: Air-to-Air UAV Detection and Identification
blocks.zh: 空对空无人驾驶飞行器探测和识别

blocks.en:
The RGB and panoramic images and the corresponding bounding boxes support the training and evaluation of air-to-air UAV detectors.
Specifically, the panoramic images cover the full surrounding airspace of the carrier UAV, and the scene and illumination labels enable the evaluation of detection robustness across backgrounds and between daytime and nighttime conditions.
Moreover, the RF time–frequency images capture the control and video links of 13 UAV models across several generations of DJI transmission systems, which supports the development of RF-based UAV identification methods.
Therefore, A2A-UAV is applicable to airborne UAV surveillance, reconnaissance, and collision avoidance.
blocks.zh:
RGB和全景图像以及相应的边框支持对空对空无人机探测器的训练和评价.
具体来说,全景图像覆盖了航空母舰整个周围的空域,场景和照明标签使得能够评价不同背景之间以及白天和夜间条件之间的探测强度。
此外,RF时间-频段图像能够捕捉几代DJI传输系统中13个无人驾驶飞行器模型的控制和视频链接,支持开发基于RF的无人驾驶飞行器识别方法。
因此,A2A-无人驾驶飞行器适用于空中无人驾驶飞行器的监视、侦察和避免碰撞。

blocks.en: Multimodal Fusion for UAV Perception
blocks.zh: UAV 感知的多式组合

blocks.en:
All modality files of a sample share a common sample identifier.
Therefore, the visual, thermal, RF, and radar observations of the same target can be paired directly for feature-level or decision-level fusion.
Specifically, the thermal images and radar point clouds provide observations that are less sensitive to illumination than the visible images, and the RF time–frequency images provide category information that is independent of the target appearance.
Moreover, the radar availability flag in the metadata enables the selection of the 105,263 samples with radar observations for fusion experiments that require all modalities.
blocks.zh:
一个样本的所有模式文件都共享一个通用的样本标识符.
因此,同一目标的视觉,热能,RF和雷达观测可以直接成对进行特征级或决定级聚变.
具体来说,热影像和雷达点云提供的观测比可见影像对照明的敏感度要低,RF时间–频率影像提供独立于目标外观的类别信息.
此外,元数据中的雷达可用旗使得能够选择105 263个带有雷达观测的样本,用于需要所有方式的聚变实验。

blocks.en: Potential Applications with Secondary Development
blocks.zh: 具有二级发展潜力的应用

blocks.en:
A2A-UAV currently provides bounding boxes for the RGB and panoramic images.
However, the dataset can be extended to further tasks through secondary annotation.
Specifically, the bounding boxes can be transferred to the thermal images to support thermal UAV detection, and the radar points can be associated with the visual targets to support radar-based UAV localization.
Moreover, the separation of UAV labels between training and evaluation supports open-set and few-shot UAV identification.
These extensions further enhance the application value of A2A-UAV in the airborne UAV perception.
blocks.zh:
A2A-UAV目前为RGB和全景图像提供边框.
然而,数据集可以通过二次注释来扩展为进一步的任务.
具体来说,捆绑箱可以转移到热成像上支持热无人机探测,雷达点可以和视觉目标联系起来支持基于雷达的无人机本地化.
此外,将无人驾驶飞行器标签在训练和评价之间分离,有助于开放式和少发的无人驾驶飞行器识别。
这些扩展进一步提高了A2A-UAV在空中无人机感知中的应用值.

blocks.en: Data Availability
blocks.zh: 数据可用性

blocks.en:
A 200-sample preview subset of A2A-UAV is hosted on Google Drive 41 at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1oCtjoF5vfH3MsPDNQEOQ84MvRywHSUso/view , and an identical mirror is provided on Baidu Netdisk at https://pan.baidu.com/s/1_P6F3z18gCyuDagdedcM2Q?pwd=A2AD with the extraction code A2AD.
The full dataset includes multimodal sensor products, sample-level metadata, RGB and panoramic bounding-box annotations, and predefined training, validation, and test splits. The data supporting the technical validation are included in the full dataset, which will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper. The preview subset provides the same data products for 200 samples. Both the preview subset and the full dataset are distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license.

A2A-UAV的200样预览子集在Google Drive 41上主机,网址为https://drive.google.com/file/d/1oCtjoF5vH3MSPDNQEOQ84MvRywHSUso/view,在Baidu Netdisk上提供一个相同的镜像,网址为https://pan.baidu.com/s/1_P6F3z18gCyuDagedcM2Q?pwd=A2AD.
完整的数据集包括多式联运传感器产品,样本级元数据,RGB和全景边框说明,以及预定义的训练,验证,测试分解. 支持技术验证的数据包含在完整的数据集中,在接受本文后将公开发布. 预览子集为200个样本提供了相同的数据产品. 预览子集和完整数据集均根据创用CC BY 4.0国际(CC BY 4.0)许可发布.

Software dependencies and reproduction instructions are provided in the accompanying documentation.
